name: Air Fryer Cauliflower Black Bean Tacos

components.name: Cauliflower & Black Bean Filling

ingredients.name: Smoked paprika, cumin and chili blend

steps: Heat the air fryer to 195 C. Toss raw cauliflower with oil and spices and place in a single layer.
Air fry cauliflower for 14-18 minutes until just crisp at edges, shaking once; cook in batches for 900 g.
Meanwhile saute onions and garlic in measured oil, add drained black beans and heat thoroughly, mashing a small fraction for taco filling.
For meal prep, store hot cauliflower and beans apart from tortillas and cold topping. Freeze beans and cauliflower only, with texture caveats.

components.name: Tortillas

ingredients.name: Eight small corn or wheat tortillas (read label)

steps: Warm tortillas briefly and fill each with spiced cauliflower and black beans; garnish with slaw, avocado and chilled yogurt.

components.name: Slaw, Avocado & Yogurt
steps: Mix cabbage, tomato and lime into slaw shortly before serving; cut fresh avocado only on serving day.

Cool cooked rice rapidly and keep refrigerated; avoid leaving rice at room temperature. Reheat rice thoroughly once.
Defrost frozen portions in the refrigerator. Re-crisp pastries, breaded vegetables and air-fried items in an oven or air fryer.
Keep delicate avocado, fresh salad, cold yogurt sauce and unbaked crisp toppings separate. They are generally not freezer-friendly.
